what.text: This page follows refugees from South Sudan in all host countries combined.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2386499 refugees from South Sudan, and Uganda hosts the largest share, 43.3%.
Sudan, Ethiopia and Kenya are the next largest hosts.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of South Sudan from 2011 to 2021 and again in 2025, with groups such as SPLM/A - IO and NAS among the government's opponents.
UCDP records the conflict at war level in 2014.

when.text: UNHCR's series for refugees from South Sudan starts in 2012 at 87007 and peaks at 2439888 in 2017.
The largest changes came between 2013 and 2014, 2015 and 2016, and 2016 and 2017, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2025.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees; asylum seekers from South Sudan are counted in a separate series.
The sources don't say which routes people took.
